svg.title: PB-EL-001 ELONGATED paddle - general arrangement
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · CF 0.3 / WAVE-RIB CORE 10 / CF 0.3 · CORE DETAIL: SHEET 3
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE THE DRAWING. UNLESS STATED: LINEAR ±0.5, ANGULAR ±0.5°.
PROFILE SYMMETRICAL ABOUT THE CENTRE LINE. ALL ARCS TANGENT TO ADJOINING EDGES.
SANDWICH: CF FACE SHEET 0.3 + WAVE-RIB CORE 10 + CF FACE SHEET 0.3 = 10.6 ±0.2, SET BY THE
MOULD (SHEET 4). BODY (SHEETS + CORE) FROM y = 5 TO THE TIP; GRIP BASE y = 0 … 5.
FACE SHEETS (2 OFF, IDENTICAL): WOVEN CARBON/EPOXY 0.3 THK (CURED), CUT TO PB-EL-001_profile.dxf
(TEMPLATE: SHEET 2), TRIMMED FLUSH WITH THE CORE EDGE.
RIB SUPPORT (CORE): 3D-PRINTED PA-CF IN ONE PIECE, CLOSED FRAME 6, WAVE RIB λ18 / WALL 1.6 /
LANDS 4.28, SOLID TO y = 150 WITH 45° FLUTE RUN-OUT – SEE SHEET 3.
SHEETS LAMINATED ONTO THE CORE IN THE TWO-HALF COMPRESSION MOULD (SHEET 4): EPOXY, ABRADED +
PRIMED CORE FACES, CLOSED TO THE HARD STOP.
STRENGTH: NOT QUALIFIED. THE HAND CHECK (analysis/hand_check.json) GIVES RF < 1 FOR THE 500 N
BALL IMPACT WITH 0.3 SHEETS (HANDLE ABOVE THE GRIP, SKIN BETWEEN LANDS) – SEE THE README.
GRIP: PRINTED PLA GRIP (ANY OF THE TEN REV-8 DESIGNS; DRAWN: CARBON MATRIX, 61 g), LOCKED BY A DIN 7984
M3 × 12 SCREW INTO AN M3 HEAT-SET INSERT. REV-8 SLOT 16 > HANDLE 10.6: REGENERATE – PB-GR-002.
USA PICKLEBALL LIMITS: L + W = 590 ≤ 609.6 (24 in), L = 390 ≤ 431.8 (17 in), INCL. GRIP.
AN EDGE GUARD COUNTS TOWARDS THESE LIMITS (MARGIN 19.6).
MASS 323 g WITH THE GRIP, BALANCE POINT 198 FROM THE BUTT (FROM THE 3D MODEL).
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · 390 × 200 × 10.6 mm · CF / WAVE-RIB SANDWICH
